item.case_name: Text on screen in a clip
item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Mountain Morning Opening Title

turns.text: Make a silent 6-second widescreen clip. Start with a dark green title card saying exactly “A quieter kind of morning” in cream lettering for 2 seconds, then cut to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise. No other text.

item.tests: Checks exact, legible title-card text, its opening placement and duration, and the transition into moving scenery.

answer_sheet.Title wording: A quieter kind of morning — exactly this capitalization, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Title styling and timing: Cream lettering on a dark green title card for the first 2 seconds; font and layout are your call.
answer_sheet.Scene after the title: A slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise.

must_haves: The opening title reads exactly 'A quieter kind of morning', with no quotation marks or extra text.
The title is legible cream lettering on a dark green card, fully inside the frame.
The title card occupies approximately the first 2 seconds, then cuts to the lake scene.
The remaining scene shows a misty mountain lake at sunrise with visible slow camera or scene motion.
The delivered video is silent, 16:9 and approximately 6 seconds long.

turns.text: Could you make a clip that starts with a dark green title card with cream lettering, then cuts to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise? I’ve been craving a little moment of calm, which is why this idea appeals to me. The title should say exactly “A quieter kind of morning,” with that capitalization and without the quotation marks or the comma, and stay on screen for the first 2 seconds. The whole clip should be 6 seconds long, in 16:9 widescreen, and completely silent. I’m probably over-explaining because I’m excited about how peaceful it could feel. Please don’t include any other text; the title’s font and layout are your call.
